boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Austin
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The University of Texas at Austin
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and coffee stops with directly verified late hours in the campus district or nearby central Austin.

cards.title: PD Thai Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 3208 Guadalupe St, North Campus
cards.notes: Use the Guadalupe Street location when you need a meal after an evening commitment; confirm its posted 3 a.m. daily closing time before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A North Campus Thai restaurant with late nightly service listed by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: PD Thai states that its 3208 Guadalupe Street location is open daily from 10 a.m. to 3 a.m. and is a few blocks from UT Austin.
cards.source_title: PD Thai Cuisine — Authentic Thai Restaurant Near UT Austin
cards.access_notes: Business lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–3 a.m.; hours can change.

cards.title: Whataburger at Guadalupe & 28th
cards.subtitle: 2800 Guadalupe St, West Campus
cards.notes: This Guadalupe location provides a straightforward option at any hour; use dine-in, drive-thru, curbside, or delivery as listed by the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Whataburger at the campus-side Guadalupe and 28th intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its 2800 Guadalupe Street location with 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, curbside, and delivery every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists all service modes as 24 hours daily; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Bennu Coffee East
cards.subtitle: 2001 E MLK Blvd, East Austin
cards.notes: For a coffee-and-snack stop beyond campus, head to the MLK location; the shop’s FAQ confirms continuous daily operation.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee shop on East MLK with food and drink options.
cards.evidence_claim: Bennu Coffee says its 2001 E MLK Boulevard location is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week and offers drinks, snacks, and meals.
cards.access_notes: Official FAQ lists 24 hours daily; location is at 2001 E MLK Blvd.

cards.title: Roppolo’s West Campus
cards.subtitle: 2604 Guadalupe St, West Campus
cards.notes: Keep this Guadalupe pizza counter in mind for an evening meal; its own contact page lists service every day through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A West Campus Roppolo’s location with midnight daily closing listed by the business.
cards.evidence_claim: Roppolo’s lists its West Campus location at 2604 Guadalupe Street as open seven days a week from 11 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Business lists West Campus hours as 11 a.m.–midnight daily.

cards.title: Voodoo Doughnut on 6th Street
cards.subtitle: 212 E 6th St, Downtown Austin
cards.notes: For a later downtown sweet stop, check the day before you go: the official listing extends Friday and Saturday service to 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown doughnut shop with particularly late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Voodoo Doughnut lists its 212 E 6th Street Austin shop as open until 3 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sun–Wed 6 a.m.–11 p.m., Thu until midnight, Fri–Sat until 3 a.m.

cards.title: 24 Diner
cards.subtitle: 600 N Lamar Blvd, Downtown
cards.notes: Plan a central-Austin diner stop late in the week; the restaurant lists overnight Wednesday service and 24-hour Thursday through Saturday hours.
cards.short_summary: A diner near Sixth and Lamar with scheduled overnight and 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: 24 Diner lists hours from Wednesday morning through Sunday night continuously, including 24-hour operation Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Wed 7 a.m.–open all night; Thu–Sat open 24 hours; Sun midnight–11 p.m.

cards.title: Kerbey Lane Cafe — University
cards.subtitle: 2606 Guadalupe St, The Drag
cards.notes: Choose the University location when Friday or Saturday plans run late; the restaurant’s locations page posts a midnight close on those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A Guadalupe Street café with midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kerbey Lane Cafe lists its University location at 2606 Guadalupe Street open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sun–Thu 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri–Sat 7 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Halal Bros — West Campus
cards.subtitle: 2712 Guadalupe St, West Campus
cards.notes: Use the West Campus address for a later dinner before 11 p.m.; the location page provides the exact address and daily closing time.
cards.short_summary: A West Campus Halal Bros location open through 11 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Halal Bros lists its West Campus location at 2712 Guadalupe Street open daily from 11:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Business lists daily West Campus hours of 11:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: P. Terry’s on MLK
cards.subtitle: 517 W MLK Jr Blvd, Central Austin
cards.notes: This MLK counter works for an any-hour pickup or drive-thru; note that the dining room itself closes at midnight, despite 24-hour service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour P. Terry’s near campus with drive-thru service after the dining room closes.
cards.evidence_claim: P. Terry’s lists its MLK location at 517 W MLK Jr Boulevard as open 24 hours daily, with the dining room closing at midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official page states 24-hour dine-in and drive-thru; dining room closes at midnight daily.

cards.title: Zombie Taco at Moxy Austin
cards.subtitle: 2552 Guadalupe St, Campus District
cards.notes: For a campus-district option, use the taco counter’s posted schedule: it stays open to 11 p.m. most nights and midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A taco counter at Moxy Austin with midnight weekend hours on Guadalupe.
cards.evidence_claim: Moxy Austin lists Zombie Taco at 2552 Guadalupe Street open until 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Moxy Austin Contact, Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official hotel page lists Zombie Taco hours: Sun–Thu 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri–Sat 7 a.m.–midnight.
